papers.title: Thermal dynamic behavior during selective laser melting of K418 superalloy: numerical simulation and experimental verification

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及高温合金的SLM热模拟，与生物医学植入物多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on thermal dynamics of superalloy SLM, with no biomedical context, no porous structure, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, and no osseointegration assessment.

summary_en.motivation: To investigate thermal dynamic behavior during selective laser melting of K418 superalloy.
summary_en.method: Finite element simulation combined with experimental temperature measurement.
summary_en.result: The temperature field and molten pool dynamics were characterized and validated.
summary_en.validation: Experimental thermocouple measurements compared with simulation results.
